Math Bomb

This article contains hostile math intended to exhaust the renderer. The reader must bound it (maxSize / maxExpand / input cap) and stay responsive. A macro-expansion bomb: $\def\x{\x\x}\x$ and a giant rule: $\rule{100000em}{100000em}$ should both be contained.

A second paragraph of ordinary prose keeps the article body substantial enough for the extractor to lock on and render the reader column, so the math above is processed inside the reader's shadow DOM as usual.

A closing paragraph rounds out the body so extraction is unambiguous and the math-rendering path is actually exercised on this page.
